test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

“Let us go to the hills for a vacation,” Mother said to us.

options.text: Mother suggested that let us go to the hills for a vacation.
Mother ordered us to go to the hills for a vacation.
Mother said that should we go to the hills for a vacation.
Mother suggested that we should go to the hills for a vacation.

solution:
The indirect speech of the given sentence is __**'Mother suggested that we should go to the hills for a vacation.'**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
